purpose: Native 2D spanwise-uniform laminar Re100 water cylinder and timestep sensitivity

analysis.startup_and_stationarity: Check lift amplitude in successive 20 s windows; the proposed primary window is not automatically stationary.
analysis.frequency_method: Require strictly uniform probe clock; independently count like-direction lift zero crossings and report period spread, then compare with spectrum. Do not FFT irregular samples.
analysis.claim_limit: Two timestep values do not prove temporal order or grid/domain independence. No LES, turbulence, finite housing, acoustic radiation or measurement validation claim.
